description: Create many issues of one project at once (up to 2000), e.g. a list or a payment history moved from a spreadsheet or another CRM. New fields can be created in the same call. Rows that fail are reported (row, title, error) while the others are created.

fields.description: fields to create first when the project has none of that name

issues.description: one object per issue; fields as on create_issue (payments = a list of {amount, currency?, date, paid, note})

name: import_issues
